collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A village dog falls asleep against a villager's feet.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: A village dog falls asleep against (name1)'s feet. (name1) decides not to move for a while.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: A village dog falls asleep against (name1)'s feet. The dog twitches in its sleep, chasing something in a dream.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: A village dog falls asleep against (name1)'s feet. (name1)'s feet fall asleep too, and standing up becomes an adventure.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: A village dog falls asleep against (name1)'s feet. When the dog wakes, it stretches and wanders off as if nothing happened.
